_comment: Planetas legendarios que NO corresponden a un tile fijo del tablero, sino que aparecen mediante mecánicas especiales (exploración, etc.)

specialPlanets.name: Mirage
specialPlanets._note: Mirage aparece al resolver una carta de exploración de tipo 'Frontier'/espacio vacío que indica colocar el planeta Mirage en ese sistema (sistema sin planetas previos). No ocupa un tile propio del pool base.

legendaryAbility.name: Mirage Flight Academy
legendaryAbility.text: Podés agotar esta carta al final de tu turno para colocar hasta 2 fighters de tus reservas en cualquier sistema que contenga 1 o más de tus naves.

specialPlanets.name: Thunder's Edge
specialPlanets._note: CORRECTED — a previous session note here claimed 'isLegendary: false... no ability card associated', which was WRONG (confirmed via FFG's own official preview article and ti4.dronz.co's reference page). Begins the game off-board, on the 'expedition' side (6 claimable slices). Once all 6 are claimed, whoever claimed the most flips it to the 'planet' side and places it in a system of their choice (no pre-existing planet, no supernova, no printed wormhole, not inside The Fracture). Confirmed resources: 5. Influence not found in any source checked — flagged as uncertain rather than invented; treated as 0 for now. See phases/expedition.ts.

legendaryAbility.name: Jupiter Brain
legendaryAbility.text: Gain your breakthrough when you gain this card if you do not already have it. You may exhaust this card at the end of your turn to perform 1 action.

specialPlanets.name: Avernus
specialPlanets._note: Not on any board tile — placed dynamically as a token when Muaat gains their Breakthrough (Stellar Genesis), into a non-home system adjacent to a planet they control. Gained READIED (not exhausted — an explicit exception to the normal 'gained control = exhausted' rule). Can be relocated later by moving a war sun out of or through its system into a non-home system.

legendaryAbility.name: The Nucleus
legendaryAbility.text: ACTION: Exhaust this card to use the Embers of Muaat's STAR FORGE faction ability without spending a command token.

specialPlanets.name: Custodia Vigilia
specialPlanets._note: No está en el tablero — no tiene sistema ni tile. Se gana agotada, vía la tecnología de facción I.I.H.Q. Modernization (Codex III) o el breakthrough del mismo nombre (Thunder's Edge). Sus stats de recursos/influencia difieren entre versiones — ver data/factions/keleres.json's own factionSpecificPlanets entry, que ya tiene el detalle completo (2/3 en Codex III, 2/2 en Thunder's Edge) y las 3 aclaraciones de FAQ. Esta entrada central solo referencia la existencia del planeta para que specialPlanets.json quede como el índice completo de 'planetas sin tile propio'; el detalle canónico sigue viviendo en el archivo de la facción.

legendaryAbility.name: Custodia Vigilia (ability card)
legendaryAbility.text: Mientras controlás Mecatol Rex, gana SPACE CANNON 5 y Production 3. Ganás 2 command tokens cuando otro jugador gana un punto de victoria usando la segunda cláusula de "Imperial" (controlar Mecatol Rex) — no por anotar objetivos públicos con Imperial en juego.
